notes: challenge-weekly re-cropped and re-encoded from the same Unsplash photograph. The 2026-10-17 file was a centre crop at quality 78: in the weekly card's band it cut off the lifter's head, and the dark block wall broke into flat blotches. This crop is 2:1 with the head near the top, so a centred band at every card size holds the head, the bar and both hands. Same photograph, same licence, original colour, no retouching. The 2026-10-17 record in sources-2026-10-17.json stays as history.

images.content: Back view of a lifter setting up a barbell back squat in a dark block-walled gym. Real licensed editorial photograph; not a Tropos member.
images.sourceShaNote: Differs from the 2026-10-17 record's ec4290…f136c: Unsplash's image service re-encodes its JPEGs. Same photograph, checked side by side against the earlier file.
